commands.author: earlvanze

target.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Embedded after-compaction hooks need a safe way to request a fresh session after compaction. The unsafe version exposed the gateway reset service directly from inside the hook, which could await reset while the active embedded run was still executing the hook, and it let hook code pass arbitrary session keys.

This PR fixes the OpenClaw core lifecycle boundary by making `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` current-session scoped and deferred. Hook code can request `"new"` or `"reset"`, but cannot name another session. The owning embedded-run or compaction lifecycle drains the queued request after hook dispatch / run execution has exited.

## Summary

- Replaces arbitrary-key hook reset with current-session-scoped `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)`.
- Defers hook-requested resets until the owning lifecycle has left hook dispatch / embedded-run execution, avoiding the active-run self-wait path in the gateway reset service.
- Wires the deferred reset queue through run-level hooks, direct compaction after-hooks, and queued/context-engine-owned after-compaction hooks.
- Adds regression coverage for deferred execution, current-session binding, and overflow compaction hook API availability.

## Evidence

### Hatched Egg / Behavior Evidence

This is an OpenClaw core lifecycle fix, not a Remnic property-data fix. Remnic/context compaction exposed the symptom, but the missing boundary is in OpenClaw's embedded-agent hook/session reset API.

Live gateway evidence from `openclaw_gateway_1` on July 16, 2026 shows the deployed runtime lacked this API and cron runs kept retrying through overflow/compaction instead of getting a fresh session:

```text
[diagnostic] long-running session ... sessionKey=agent:discord-public:cron:discord-public-heartbeat:run:59ea4170... activeWorkKind=model_call cronJobId=discord-public-heartbeat
[agent/embedded] context overflow detected (attempt 1/3); attempting auto-compaction for sage-router/frontier
[plugins] remnic: compaction completed for agent:discord-public:cron:discord-public-heartbeat:run:59ea4170..., triggering session reset
[plugins] remnic: api.resetSession not available - compaction reset requires OC fork with PR #29985. Session ... will continue without reset.
[agent/embedded] auto-compaction succeeded for sage-router/frontier; retrying prompt
[agent/embedded] context overflow detected (attempt 2/3); attempting auto-compaction for sage-router/frontier
[plugins] remnic: api.resetSession not available - compaction reset requires OC fork with PR #29985. Session ... will continue without reset.
[agent/embedded] context overflow detected (attempt 3/3); attempting auto-compaction for sage-router/frontier
[plugins] remnic: api.resetSession not available - compaction reset requires OC fork with PR #29985. Session ... will continue without reset.
```

A later hourly `discord-public-heartbeat` cron run repeated the same pattern with a new run session key (`agent:discord-public:cron:discord-public-heartbeat:run:9c60c213...`): overflow, compaction, reset request, API unavailable, then prompt retry. That ties the observed cron retry loop to the missing OpenClaw hook API rather than to Remnic property data.

After this PR, the hook receives:

```ts
await hookContext.api.resetSession("new");
```

and OpenClaw queues a current-session-only reset request for the lifecycle owner to flush after hook dispatch / embedded-run execution. The hook cannot target another session key, and reset failures are logged without turning cron completion into a scheduler retry.

### Live Rollout Proof

I applied the same reset-queue behavior to two real `openclaw_gateway_1` runtimes that were on `2026.6.11`.

Cyber:

```text
Config valid: /home/umbrel/.openclaw/openclaw.json
Gateway ready after restart
Health: Discord configured, Telegram configured, WhatsApp linked
/usr/local/lib/node_modules/openclaw/dist/embedded-agent-Cv8lGIPa.js: createEmbeddedHookSessionResetQueue present
/usr/local/lib/node_modules/openclaw/dist/run-session-target-D5j70_wT.js: buildCompactionHookApi present
```

Sovereign:

```text
Config valid: ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json
Telegram: configured
Gateway event loop: ok
/usr/local/lib/node_modules/openclaw/dist/embedded-agent-Cv8lGIPa.js: createEmbeddedHookSessionResetQueue present
/usr/local/lib/node_modules/openclaw/dist/run-session-target-D5j70_wT.js: buildCompactionHookApi present
```

Post-restart log probes on both hosts showed no new `api.resetSession not available` messages in the verification window.

## Validation

Rebased onto `origin/main` at `f193c505777d` and pushed as `5a7a21ae0359`.

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/compact.hooks.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run.overflow-compaction.test.ts

Test Files  2 passed (2)
Tests       175 passed (175)
```

```text
$ node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-pr-compaction-hook-api.tsbuildinfo
# passed
```

```text
$ node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.agents.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test-agents-pr-compaction-hook-api.tsbuildinfo
# passed
```

```text
# passed
```

## Summary

- Regenerates the social card artifact after the provider-count update.

## Verification
- `swift test --filter ClinePass`
- `make check`

## Summary
- Adds the AnyRouter provider from #2171.
- Covers management-key credit fetching, scoped-out key handling, provider registration, docs, icons, and parser hash update for this standalone branch.
- Aligns setup guidance, Settings token-account copy, and errors with AnyRouter's `/credits` credential contract: use an `ak_...` management key with `read:credits`; inference keys like `sk-ar-v1-...` are not accepted by that endpoint.
- Includes the black logo simplification from the source PR follow-up commits.

## Verification
- `swift test --filter AnyRouter`
- `make check`
